quizName: Hardest Questions in Oklahoma Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you properly if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting on it.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars go over your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting on it.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly when your feet can touch the ground while you sit on it. You should be able to reach and operate all the controls easily.

questions.question: You should wear a jacket when riding a motorcycle:

options.text: Only if you will ride for more than half an hour.

questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even in warm weather. It protects you from the sun and helps prevent dehydration in hot weather.

questions.question: Most motorcycles have which types of brakes?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake does more of the braking work than the rear brake.

questions.question: To get the best protection, wear a helmet that:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no cracks or damage.

questions.question: The best thing you can do to survive a crash is to:

options.text: Wear a quality helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a quality helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a quality helmet that is securely fastened is the most effective way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: If your shoes have laces, you should:
questions.explanation: Always tuck in your shoelaces securely so they do not catch on the motorcycle while you ride.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle you have never used before, you should:

options.text: Test the seat to see if it is comfortable.
Assume the motorcycle is in good condition.
Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding.
Ride normally, since all bikes are similar.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding, get familiar with the bike. Practice using the throttle, clutch, and brakes to learn how the bike handles.

questions.question: When riding, you should constantly look ahead for:
questions.explanation: Look ahead to stay alert to changing traffic, hazardous road conditions, and possible escape routes. Be ready to react to any changes.

questions.question: A danger of riding next to parked cars is:

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
Other drivers may be looking for a parking spot.
The road surface may be uneven.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
questions.explanation: Riding next to parked cars is dangerous because a driver might pull out into your path without looking. A car door may open into your lane, or a person may step out from between cars.

questions.question: A motorcycle has the best traction on which surface?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces reduce tire traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers are more dangerous for a motorcycle than dry pavement.

questions.question: How does riding with a passenger affect a motorcycle?

options.text: It usually makes no difference in how the motorcycle handles.
It is usually safe for new riders.
It can change how the motorcycle handles.
It is encouraged to help riders practice different situations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can change how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight to the motorcycle. This changes how the motorcycle handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: What kind of shoe soles should motorcycle riders wear?

options.text: Material that lets your feet breathe

questions.explanation: Choose riding boots or shoes that are high and sturdy to support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: What helmet choice gives you the most protection?

options.text: A helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards
A helmet that has been in a crash before
A helmet that provides hearing protection

questions.correctAnswerText: A helmet that meets U.S. DOT standards
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. Your helmet should fit snugly all the way around your head.

questions.question: What happens when you take a turn too fast?

options.text: It is acceptable as long as you stay under the speed limit
It is safer on a motorcycle than in a car
It is acceptable as long as no other vehicles are nearby
You may end up in another lane or leave the road

questions.correctAnswerText: You may end up in another lane or leave the road
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast is dangerous. If you cannot hold the turn, you may drift into another lane or go off the road. Always slow down before taking a turn.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. This takes only a few minutes and helps prevent problems before you enter traffic.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up

questions.explanation: Do not ride if you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break at least every two hours to avoid getting too tired.

questions.question: What should you check during a pre-ride inspection?

options.text: How worn your tires are and their tread depth
How much padding your seat has
Which direction the wind is blowing

questions.correctAnswerText: How worn your tires are and their tread depth
questions.explanation: Before you ride, check your tires, oil and fluid levels, headlight, tail light, turn signals, brake light, clutch, throttle, mirrors, brakes, and horn.

questions.question: What is the best gear to wear when you ride?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you while riding. Use a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: Which of these is a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal covers can be slippery. Ride with extra care on these surfaces.

questions.question: What can happen when you take a corner too fast?

options.text: You may drift into another lane
It is better than going too slowly
You will usually stay in your lane
It is safe because motorcycles are smaller than other vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drift into another lane
questions.explanation: Taking a corner too fast may cause you to cross into another lane or go off the road. Slow down before you start a turn or curve.
